summary: Kinross Gold filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting Q2 2026 earnings and a capital-return program. The company returned ~40% of free cash flow to shareholders via $480M in share repurchases H1 2026 plus $40M in July and a $0.04/share quarterly dividend, totaling ~$615M year-to-date. Since April 2025, $1.1B has been returned, repurchasing ~4% of shares outstanding. No transaction price, premium, or advisor is stated. The program is ongoing with a target of 40% of free cash flow. Watch for sustained free cash flow generation and pace of future buybacks.
